name: Admin Document Send Email
description: Admin sends a branded email with document PDFs attached from the documents list: actions sheet -> 'Enviar por correo' opens SendDocumentEmailModal (recipient, subject, greeting, ordered sections, footer, extra document PDFs picker, Edit/Preview tabs) -> POST /api/emails/send/ with document_ids. Functional successor of the superseded admin-proposal-documents-send flow.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-22 (QA campaign): happy path, 429 rate-limited and generic-error branches over mocked API.
